description: A delta file (§13.8.1 to §13.8.3). begin in chunks format answers mode chunks, and its size and sha256 are the stored manifest's. The plan call names the file's chunks: all missing, then all present once they are sent. A chunk the plan did not name, a wrong digest and a plan with a repeated id are refused. finalize answers upload_incomplete with the chunk ids still missing, then with part 1 while the manifest is absent; the manifest goes to the single PUT. The resume answer lists no chunk missing, finalize commits format chunks, the download is the manifest and a chunk GET returns the stored object. A chunk of a collection without delta is not found.

steps.note: A collection without files.delta refuses the chunks format.
Create-only: the manifest's size and hash.
The plan call: three ids, none stored yet.
A repeated id is a bad request, and nothing is taken.
Send the first chunk.
A chunk the plan did not name is refused.
A digest that is not the object's is refused and nothing is stored.
Two chunks are missing: the ids come back.
Send the second chunk.
Send the third chunk.
Naming the ids again: all present now, with their stored sizes.
Every chunk is there; the manifest (part 1) is not.
The manifest goes up through the single PUT.
Resume answer: the manifest is part 1, no chunk is missing.
Commit.
The file the record points at is its manifest.
One chunk object, as stored.
One chunk object, as stored.
A chunk no file references is not found.
The same id in another collection is not found.
